title: Check Token: Real-Time Self-Verification and Precise Truncation in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ECC memory embeds 8 parity bits for every 64 data bits and automatically detects and corrects errors on each read. The parity bits carry no data and only safeguard integrity, at ~12.5% overhead. Yet the reasoning chains of large language models lack such built-in self-verification: once an error occurs it propagates along the chain, and existing methods can only verify externally after generation completes. We propose the check token, establishing built-in self-verification for language model generation streams for the first time: a functional marker  is added to the vocabulary, and the model triggers self-checking (analysis, localization, truncation, rewriting) by outputting it at any position. The check token carries no reasoning content (discarded after triggering) and only safeguards reasoning correctness, directly corresponding to the role of ECC parity bits, also at only ~13% overhead. translated_title: 检查标记：大语言模型推理中的实时自验证与精确截断
translated_abstract: ECC内存为每64位数据嵌入8个奇偶校验位，并在每次读取时自动检测和纠正错误。这些校验位不承载数据，仅用于保障完整性，开销约为12.5%。然而，大语言模型的推理链缺乏这种内置的自验证机制：一旦发生错误，错误便会沿链条传播，而现有方法只能在生成完成后进行外部验证。我们提出“检查标记”，首次为语言模型生成流建立了内置自验证机制：在词表中添加一个功能性标记，模型通过在任意位置输出该标记来触发自检流程（分析、定位、截断、重写）。检查标记不承载推理内容（触发后被丢弃），仅用于保障推理正确性，直接对应ECC奇偶校验位的角色，开销同样仅为约13%。推测分叉机制进一步消除了误……
tldr: 受ECC奇偶校验位启发，本文提出“检查标记”机制，首次在大语言模型推理生成流中实现内置实时自验证，使模型能在任意位置触发自检、定位并精确截断重写错误内容，仅以约13%的额外开销保障推理链正确性。
en_tdlr: Inspired by ECC parity bits, this paper proposes the "check token," which for the first time establishes built-in real-time self-verification in LLM reasoning streams, allowing the model to trigger self-checking, localize, and precisely truncate and rewrite errors at any position with only ~13% overhead.
